title: I design with Claude more than Figma now
summary: A Jane Street engineer shares their experience of using Claude Code as their primary design tool instead of traditional tools like Figma, demonstrating how AI-powered coding workflows are changing design processes.
problem_solved: Streamlines the design process by using AI coding assistants to create UI designs directly through code rather than visual design tools.
why_valuable: Shows a practical real-world example of how AI is transforming professional design workflows at a respected quantitative trading firm.
